messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Inactive ingredients (single-dose pens and vials):

- Glycerin

Triplet: ["Zepbound", "contains", "Glycerin"]

The relation 'contains' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug includes the substance or component specified by the object entity as part of its formulation.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'passes into': The subject drug is transferred or present in the substance or medium specified by the object entity.
B. 'has related drug': The subject drug is related to or associated with another drug specified by the object entity.
C. 'can be used with': The subject drug can be administered concurrently with the substance or medication specified by the object entity.
D. 'may have added': The subject drug may include the substance specified by the object entity to adjust or maintain its pH.
E. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
